title: Skirmish/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Cephalon Cy: "Shatter Grineer operational capacity in this sector. Targets marked."
- Cephalon Cy: "This is a raid. Eliminating priority targets and defensive units will negatively impact enemy cohesion."'
- Cephalon Cy: "Enemy forces on scope. Delete."
- Cephalon Cy: "Targets on the board. Good hunting."
- Cephalon Cy: "Entering operational theater. Hit them until they do not get up."
- Cephalon Cy: "Grineer in sector. Let's change that."
- Cephalon Cy: "Bad guys. Hit them in the knees."
- Cephalon Cy: "Clear this sector. A decisive first strike will increase odds of victory by 147%."
- Cephalon Cy: "Looks like the Grineer are feeling lucky. Good hunting."
- Cephalon Cy: "Grineer. Hit them where it hurts."

path: Mission Complete With No Other Objectives
lines: - Cephalon Cy: "Enemy in retreat. Sector secured. Drawing a line on this one."
- Cephalon Cy: "Sector secured. Enemy has turned tailed. Mission complete."
- Cephalon Cy: "The enemy is no longer a viable threat. Your tactics were sound. Resolving mission brief. Nav ready for new heading."
- Cephalon Cy: "Grineer in disarray. Sector secured. Mission successful."
- Cephalon Cy: "Not a board warm-up. Objectives met. Moving on."
- Cephalon Cy: "Enemy forces beheaded. Threats neutralized. Closing mission. Next."
- Cephalon Cy: "Enemy infrastructure neutralized. Filing mission as complete."
- Cephalon Cy: "Enemy in retreat. Surviving Grineer will spread the word. Mission resolved."
- Cephalon Cy: "Your efforts proved inadequate. Reflect on this. Mission aborted."
- Cephalon Cy: "We have lost the day. Mission logged as failure."
- Cephalon Cy: "Failure. Aborting mission. This performance must be examined."
- Cephalon Cy: "Mission failed. This is... suboptimal."
- Cephalon Cy: "I am scrubbing the mission. We are done here."
- Cephalon Cy: "I am pulling us out. We have lost the day."
- Cephalon Cy: "I am pulling you out. There will be other days."
- Cephalon Cy: "I was unprepared. I will consider this and improve. Come on home."
- Cephalon Cy: "You were unprepared. This is on me."
- Cephalon Cy: "Get out of there. We can try again later."
- Cephalon Cy: "Aborting. Better to fail the mission than fail you."
- Cephalon Cy: "Our losses can be replaced. You cannot. I am pulling you out."
- Cephalon Cy: "Crew. A missile battery is disrupting civilian traffic in this sector. This intimidation cannot be allowed stand. Marking objectives."
- Cephalon Cy: "A missile battery is operating in this vicinity. A clear first step in Grineer's efforts to control this sector. Neutralize it. Be careful."
- Cephalon Cy: "Crew. Missile battery. Standard op. If we do not dig the Grineer out now, they will reinforce and then it becomes a whole other thing."
- Cephalon Cy: "The Grineer call their missile batteries a persistent reminder of Grineer superiority and dominance. I call them practice. Objectives marked."
- Cephalon Cy: "Crew get inside that missile battery. Objective: expose the core's radiators."
- Cephalon Cy: "Target: missile battery. Orders: infiltrate. Objective: expose radiators. Destroy core."
- Cephalon Cy: "Missile battery. It has to go. Standard op. Infiltrate and slag the core. Execute."
- Cephalon Cy: "That is the problem with missile batteries. They are packed with explosives. Cook up gutted the place. Moving on."
- Cephalon Cy: "That last shot cooked off every missile rack they had. Target neutralized."
- Cephalon Cy: "Hit and run. Good job. Let's move on."
- Cephalon Cy: "Missile battery internals slagged. Everyone in one piece? Let us move on."
- Cephalon Cy: "There she goes. Missile battery down. Take a breath and redirect."
- Cephalon Cy: "Scratch one high payload kinetic kill station. I have no idea how those chumps keep paying for those. Moving on."
- Cephalon Cy: "Targets eliminated. Missile battery neutralized. I'll notify the Ostrons. They can turn it into a wreck center."
- Cephalon Cy: "Missle battery is toast. Contacting nearby Solaris craft. They could use the parts."
- Cephalon Cy: "Objectives fulfilled. Local scavengers will have that place stripped in a couple of cycles. No further action needed."
- Cephalon Cy: "Grineer forces routed from system. Missile battery rendered nonviable. Sector secured. Closing mission dossier."
- Cephalon Cy: "Grineer dry dock. They are working on something. I want to know what. Infiltrate."
- Cephalon Cy: "Strange place for a hangar. Find out why it is here."
- Cephalon Cy: "Interesting. Grineer hangar. Here for a reason. Find out that reason and steal it."
- Cephalon Cy: "Prototype destroyer. On lockdown. Rupture the hangar's core to disable lockdown."
- Cephalon Cy: "Prototype craft. One of a kind. It would be terrible if someone stole it."
- Cephalon Cy: "Experimental Grineer war vessel. Locked down tight. Take it for a spin. I want to read its logs."
- Cephalon Cy: "R&D facility. Steal the command crewship. I want copies of everything."
- Cephalon Cy: "Ship stolen. Downloading navigation data. Nice work hotshot."
- Cephalon Cy: "These specs will make for interesting reading. Do what you want with that ship. I have what I need."
- Cephalon Cy: "You can cool your jets. Downloading specs. Good work."
- Cephalon Cy: "All research acquired and copied. Excellent work. We can get out of here."
- Cephalon Cy: "It will take some time to parse these millions of files. Meantime, enjoy your new jets."'
- Cephalon Cy: "R&D acquired. We know people who can make good use of this."

- Cephalon Cy: "The Grineer commander could not be made to hede a warning against building an asteroid base here. We can only make him wish that he had. Get over there and redecorate it from the inside. Him too."
- Cephalon Cy: "Asteroid base. Its commander is a known war criminal, lives on vobi butter, and smells like a blown out mens' room. Take him out. Leave an air freshener."

- Cephalon Cy: "A Grineer commander is using this asteroid base to broadcast propaganda. You can eat a dictionary and crap more sense than he makes. But he still needs to go. Infiltrate and terminate."
- Cephalon Cy: "There is an asteroid base in this sector. It serves as a point of coordination for forces in surrounding sectors. Infiltrate the base. Terminate the commander."
- Cephalon Cy: "Strange: That asteroid base was not here before. Target and kill its commander."
- Cephalon Cy: "Crew, a new asteroid base. Nip this in the bud. Infiltrate and terminate the commander."
- Cephalon Cy: "Asteroid base. We cannot leave this here. Infiltrate the base and terminate the commander."
- Cephalon Cy: "Asteroid base on scope. Get over there and terminate the commander."
- Cephalon Cy: "There, that's the commander. Get them dead."
- Cephalon Cy: "Commander spotted. We need that target dead yesterday."
- Cephalon Cy: "You are right on the target."
- Cephalon Cy: "The commander is right there. Do your thing."
- Cephalon Cy: "Asteroid hierarchy: crippled. We are good to go. Mission wrapped."
- Cephalon Cy: "Asteroid commander done and dusted. Sector clear. We are done here."
- Cephalon Cy: "Hearing chatter referencing a shift in command. The Queens already have a replacement en route, but this will set them back a while."
- Cephalon Cy: "Grineer Commander terminated. That is all we needed to achieve in this sector. Time to move on."
- Cephalon Cy: "Need Tenno on the inside. Breach their systems."
- Cephalon Cy: "Get inside and extend the radiators."
- Cephalon Cy: "One of you needs to get in there and breach their systems."
- Cephalon Cy: "The Grineer placement of a pulse turbine is a display of power intended to intimidate. We do not do intimidated. Operational objectives updated."
- Cephalon Cy: "A nearby pulse turbine is strengthening the Grineer fleet. Strategically, for us, this could be a pain in the neck. Take it out."
- Cephalon Cy: "Crew: time for housekeeping. Take out the Grineer pulse turbine and any resistance you encounter. Send a message."

- Cephalon Cy: "Crew: in the interest of sector security, I have marked a nearby Grineer pulse turbine. Take it down, then knock the slats out of anything left standing. In the interest of sector security."
- Cephalon Cy: "We have a pulse turbine reinforcing enemy fighters. I need an away crew on the inside."
- Cephalon Cy: "We have a pulse turbine strengthening enemy craft. Get on board and shut it down."
- Cephalon Cy: "New target: pulse turbine. Infiltrate, disable reactors, neutralize core. As long as that turbine is running, the enemy is emboldened, and our progress impeded."
- Cephalon Cy: "Pulse turbine reinforcing enemy units. Who is going in?"
- Cephalon Cy: "Pulse turbine rendered inoperative. Let us see how the enemy handles an even playing field."
- Cephalon Cy: "Turbine nixed. Our enemy has lost the advantage. Excellent."
- Cephalon Cy: "The pulse turbine is still. Enemy forces are destabilized. They are unused to meeting an enemy on equal terms. Cowards."
- Cephalon Cy: "Turbine fragged. Secondary targets eliminated. Grineer fleet is backing off. Good work. We are making a difference."
- Cephalon Cy: "Turbine offline. The Queens will not be happy. Good. Closing out the mission."
- Cephalon Cy: "Turbine offline. I will spread the word that this sector has re-opened. Solid work."
- Cephalon Cy: "Closing the file on that pulse turbine. Good work. They will be back, but for now this sector is clear."
- Cephalon Cy: "Shipkiller platform spotted in-sector. This is now a priority target."
- Cephalon Cy: "Crew: energy signatures indicate the presence of a Grineer shipkiller platform. Infiltrate and neutralize."
- Cephalon Cy: "The Grineer have deployed a shipkiller platform to this sector. That explains the lack of civilian radio traffic. Take it down."
- Cephalon Cy: "Shipkiller platform identified. This is a priority target. Infiltrate and disable. It is impossible to say how many innocents may have already lost their lives to it."
- Cephalon Cy: "Eyes on shipkiller platform. Clearing the sector will be difficult while it is operational. Take it out of commission."
- Cephalon Cy: "Shipkiller platform sighted. Priority target. I need Tenno on the inside, yesterday."
- Cephalon Cy: "Shipkiller platform neutralized. A grateful sector thanks you."
- Cephalon Cy: "Shipkiller platform offline. Permanently. Well done."
- Cephalon Cy: "Shipkiller neutralized. Suggest we move on."
- Cephalon Cy: "Shipkiller platform down. Sector cleared. That should make things easier for civilian traffic. Closing out the mission."
- Cephalon Cy: "Enemy forces pacified. Shipkiller platform neutralized. Mission resolved."
- Cephalon Cy: "Grineer galleon in system. High value personage aboard. Infiltrate and terminate."
- Cephalon Cy: "Grineer forces massing alongside that galleon. Bodyguard detail. Their captain is nervous. Infiltrate and terminate."
- Cephalon Cy: "Grineer galleon plus support. Too big to take down but you can get it. Find whoever is in charge of that thing and take them out."
- Cephalon Cy: "Primary target: Grineer galleon with support. Get on board. Locate the one calling the shots. Kill them."
- Cephalon Cy: "Galleon has translated in sector, carrying a high priority target: the captain. Infiltrate and terminate."
- Cephalon Cy: "Galleon on scope. Assassinate the captain."
- Cephalon Cy: "Galleon. Our shipboard weapons will be ineffective. Board and kill its captain."
- Cephalon Cy: "Galleon has entered the fight. This changes things. Updating target manifest: galleon captain. Board and kill."
- Cephalon Cy: "Crew. I need volunteers to board that galleon and kill its captain."
- Cephalon Cy: "That is the captain. Hit delete and come on home."
- Cephalon Cy: "Eyeballing galleon captain. Drop the hammer."
- Cephalon Cy: "Radio chatter reports galleon captain terminated. They are rudderless. Excellent work."
- Cephalon Cy: "Captain terminated. Galleon in disarray. Objective complete."
- Cephalon Cy: "Galleon captain is off the board. A perfect outcome."
- Cephalon Cy: "Galleon captain down. Support down. Sector clear. Closing mission dossier. Requesting new orders."
- Cephalon Cy: "Captain terminated. Closing mission. Crew, avail yourselves of up to, but no more than, five minutes downtime."
- Cephalon Cy: "Captain terminated. Enemy routed. Reminds me of the old days. Closing mission."
- Cephalon Cy: "The Grineer are expressing interest in unusual energy readings nearby. Investigate and deny."
- Cephalon Cy: "Grineer chatter references a nearby anomaly. Investigate and disrupt."
- Cephalon Cy: "Unusual. Energy readings I have not seen since The Old War. Investigate and clear out any hostiles."
- Cephalon Cy: "Grineer eyes on... something. I do not like the sound of this. Investigate."
- Cephalon Cy: "A Grineer expedition is moving with speed towards an empty point in space. Strange. They know something. Investigate."
- Cephalon Cy: "Crew. Something on sensors. A structure. Sentients. Prepare to board and sweep."
- Cephalon Cy: "Sentient structure. That is what drew the Grineer's interest. Crew. Infiltrate and sterilize. Leave no Sentient operational."
- Cephalon Cy: "That thing. Sentient. I saw them during the Old War. Board immediately. Sterilize to prevent the Grineer from exploiting it."
- Cephalon Cy: "Anomaly revealed. A Sentient structure. Board it. Kill everything that moves. Go now."
- Cephalon Cy: "Sentient forces decimated. Objective complete."
- Cephalon Cy: "No further Sentients are incoming. Objective complete."
- Cephalon Cy: "Sentient reinforcement has halted. Objective complete."
- Cephalon Cy: "All is quiet. Crew: you may stand down."
- Cephalon Cy: "Sentient structure secured. Mission complete."
- Cephalon Cy: "Sentient threat: eliminated. Grineer threat: eliminated. Mission successful. Stand down."
- Cephalon Cy: "All threats neutralized. Sentient structure secured. Closing out the mission."
- Cephalon Cy: "We are on their boards. Look alive."
- Cephalon Cy: "Grineer interceptors alerted. Contact imminent. Good luck."
- Cephalon Cy: "Incoming fighters. Get to stations."
- Cephalon Cy: "Multiple bogeys. Man the guns."
- Cephalon Cy: "Fighters on attack vector. Gunners: fire at will."
- Cephalon Cy: "Incoming attack craft. Crew: light them up."
- Cephalon Cy: "Fighters on scope. Take them down, wholesale."
- Cephalon Cy: "Detected: single-person attack craft. Prepare to engage."
- Cephalon Cy: "Alert. Enemy fighters have been scrambled."
- Cephalon Cy: "Bogeys on scope. Good hunting."
- Cephalon Cy: "Fighter launch detected. Bogeys closing in."
- Cephalon Cy: "Fighters incoming. Keep them off the ship."
- Cephalon Cy: "Enemy fighters down fifty percent."
- Cephalon Cy: "Enemy squadrons halved. Maintain pressure."
- Cephalon Cy: "I am seeing a lot of fighter shrapnel. Pilot morale destabilizing. continue."
- Cephalon Cy: "Enemy fighter support has been halved."
- Cephalon Cy: "Enemy pilots are panicking. Keep it up."
- Cephalon Cy: "Maintain anti-fighter cover. They are about to break."
- Cephalon Cy: "Enemy fighters on the run."
- Cephalon Cy: "We broke them. skies are clear of fighter cover."
- Cephalon Cy: "Enemy fighters are falling back. Good work."
- Cephalon Cy: "Enemy morale has broken. Fighters are peeling off."
- Cephalon Cy: "Remaining fighters are being called off. Excellent."
- Cephalon Cy: "Grineer crewship has translated in sector."
- Cephalon Cy: "We have company. Grineer crewship on scope."
- Cephalon Cy: "Looks like we have kicked the nest. Grineer crewship has punched in."
- Cephalon Cy: "Alert: Enemy crewship has translated into the sector."
- Cephalon Cy: "Alert: Enemy crewship on scope."
- Cephalon Cy: "Enemy crewship has arrived. They are powering weapons."
- Cephalon Cy: "They called some friends. Enemy crewship has punched in."
- Cephalon Cy: "The enemy have called in a crewship. Situation evolving."
- Cephalon Cy: "Reading large translation signature. Crewship. The enemy have reinforced."
- Cephalon Cy: "All hands brace for missile impact."
- Cephalon Cy: "Grineer crewship has a Tenno at the helm. Watch your fire."
- Cephalon Cy: "We have captured the enemy crewship."
- Cephalon Cy: "Enemy crewship under our command."
- Cephalon Cy: "Crewship captured. Drive it like you stole it."
- Cephalon Cy: "Crewship captured. Tenno in the saddle."
- Cephalon Cy: "Crewship reactor has detonated. Pretty."
- Cephalon Cy: "Boom. Crewship eliminated. Focus on remaining targets."
- Cephalon Cy: "Crewship down. That clears up some space."
- Cephalon Cy: "We have one less crewship to be concerned with. Direct attention to remaining targets."
- Cephalon Cy: "Crewship has gone bye bye."
- Cephalon Cy: "Sensor readings indicate nearby derelict."
- Cephalon Cy: "Crew, we have a derlict vessel on scope."
- Cephalon Cy: "We have a dead ship in range. Possible wreckage."
- Cephalon Cy: "Eyes open. We do not know what is on that thing."
- Cephalon Cy: "This is where the celestial meets the terrestrial. Derelict boarded."
- Cephalon Cy: "Crew, take what you can and get out. Remember what happened last time."
- Cephalon Cy: "Decrypting archives. Crew, you might find this interesting."
- Cephalon Cy: "The Infested. A hideous malfunction of biology. Rectify that."
- Cephalon Cy: "Key components marked. Destroy them."
- Cephalon Cy: "Away crew: Wrecking time. Destroy marked components."
- Cephalon Cy: "Marking sensitive systems. Trash the place."
- Cephalon Cy: "Exterior weakpoint exposed. Open fire."
- Cephalon Cy: "Bingo. Crew: trash that radiator."
- Cephalon Cy: "Radiator naked. Hit them with all we have got."
- Cephalon Cy: "There it is. Blast that radiator."
- Cephalon Cy: "Radiator down. Away crew: Expose the next radiator."
- Cephalon Cy: "One down, one to go."
- Cephalon Cy: "One radiator down. Make it two."
- Cephalon Cy: "Radiators destroyed. Away crew: go for the core."
